newsitem.title: AUSTRALIA: RTRS-Australia/US 10-yr yield spread holds 100 bp.
newsitem.headline: RTRS-Australia/US 10-yr yield spread holds 100 bp.

text.p: The Australian/U.S. 10-year bond yield spread was testing 100 basis points going into the close as the local market took profits on some of the spread tightening trades seen in the past week.
However, this was still nearly 20 basis down from a week ago, helped by recent speculation of a further easing in monetary policy.
The U.S. rallied strongly in New York on Thursday after a benign outcome to the U.S. December PPI core rate, but slipped in Tokyo today ahead of the key non-farm payrolls report.
The strong U.S. rally helped the local long-end outperform short-dated stocks for the first time this week, causing the yield curve to flatten sharply.

The three/10-year bond yield spread touched 110 basis points earlier this week amid intense speculation of a policy easing, although traders said there was some caution in funding positions at the short-end ahead of the U.S. data.
